title: Countries on the Equator
intro: Which countries does the line of zero latitude cross? Every answer shows its source.

questions.prompt: Which of these South American countries does the equator cross?
questions.explain: The Natural Earth outline of Ecuador spans latitude 0; Venezuela, Argentina and Chile lie entirely on one side of it.

questions.prompt: Which of these South American countries does the equator cross?
questions.explain: The Natural Earth outline of Colombia spans latitude 0; Bolivia, Paraguay and Uruguay lie entirely south of it.

questions.prompt: Which of these African countries does the equator cross?
questions.explain: The Natural Earth outline of Gabon spans latitude 0; Nigeria and Ghana are north of it and Tanzania south.

questions.prompt: Which of these Southeast Asian countries does the equator cross?
questions.explain: The Natural Earth outline of Indonesia spans latitude 0; Thailand, the Philippines and Malaysia lie wholly north of it.

questions.prompt: Which of these East African countries does the equator cross?
questions.explain: The Natural Earth outline of Kenya spans latitude 0; Ethiopia is north of it, and Tanzania and Zambia are south.

questions.prompt: Which of these Horn of Africa countries does the equator cross?
questions.explain: The Natural Earth outline of Somalia spans latitude 0; Eritrea, Djibouti and Ethiopia lie wholly north of it.

questions.prompt: Which of these East African countries is NOT crossed by the equator?
questions.explain: Tanzania lies wholly south of latitude 0 in the Natural Earth outline, while Uganda, Kenya and Somalia are each crossed by it.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries crossed by the equator has the largest area?
questions.explain: Natural Earth outlines give Brazil about 8.5 million km2, ahead of the Democratic Republic of the Congo at about 2.3 million km2.

questions.prompt: Which equator-crossing country has Libreville as its capital?
questions.explain: Libreville is the capital of Gabon; Kenya, Ecuador and Uganda are also crossed by the equator but have other capitals.

questions.prompt: Which equator-crossing country shares a land border with the Democratic Republic of the Congo?
questions.explain: Natural Earth boundary data lists Congo (capital Brazzaville) among the neighbours of the Democratic Republic of the Congo; both are crossed by the equator.
